foundation: Calculus of Inductive Constructions with Quotients (CIC + Quot)

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: induction n with | zero => h0 | succ n' ih => hsucc
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Dependent elimination constructing an inductive motive with automated unification of index equations.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Use induction for recursive types, rcases for structured destruction with tuple unpacking, and nomatch for empty types.
dialect_pitfalls: Variable capture during induction hypothesis instantiation
Accidental generalization of non-variable terms
Loss of index equality constraints if using naive cases instead of rcases
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: induction n with | zero => h0 | succ n' ih => hsucc

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: by decide
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Kernel evaluation of instances of Decidable p reducing decide p = true to definitional equality.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Use by decide for bounded finite combinatorial checks; use omega for Presburger integer arithmetic.
dialect_pitfalls: Expensive kernel reduction triggering maximum heartbeat limits
Typeclass resolution failure if Decidable instance is missing or noncomputable
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: by decide

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: simp only [add_comm, mul_zero]
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Leibniz substitution via Eq.rec for rw; confluent term rewriting using congruence lemmas and contextual discrimination trees for simp.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Use rw for explicit targeted steps; use simp only [...] in maintainable production code to avoid unconstrained simplifier loops.
dialect_pitfalls: Non-terminating simplifier loops when non-decreasing lemmas are added to simp
Hidden typeclass synthesis failures during rewrite
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: simp only [add_comm, mul_zero]

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: class Group (G : Type u) extends Monoid G, Inv G where ...
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Tableau-based backward search with cached instances, out-parameters, and default field synthesis.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Extend flatter semi-bundled structures; avoid diamonds with inconsistent data fields; use outParam carefully.
dialect_pitfalls: Exponential synthesis time from looping or depth-unbounded instance declarations
Diamond conflicts where two paths synthesize distinct data fields
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: class Group (G : Type u) extends Monoid G, Inv G where ...

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: aesop (add safe ...) or omega
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Whitebox tree search over rule sets with custom normalization, safe/unsafe rule splits, and Cooper LIA decision.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Configure domain-specific aesop rule sets; discharge linear integer constraints with omega and ring equalities with ring.
dialect_pitfalls: Aesop explosion on branching unsafe rules
Non-reproducible proof timings if search limits drift
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: aesop (add safe ...) or omega

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: calc a = b := h1 _ <= c := h2 _ < d := h3
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Transitivity typeclass synthesis Trans r1 r2 r3 combining intermediate relation witnesses.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Use calc for multi-step analytic inequalities; Lean 4 automatically fills the omitted left-hand side.
dialect_pitfalls: Transitivity instance missing for custom relations
Mismatched relations (e.g. strict vs non-strict order transitivity)
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: calc a = b := h1 _ <= c := h2 _ < d := h3

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: Quot.sound (h : a ~ b) or Quotient.lift f h_resp
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Primitive kernel quotient types (Quot) satisfying computational reduction and propositional extensionality.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Define a Setoid instance, then construct types via Quotient s and lift maps via Quotient.lift.
dialect_pitfalls: Accidental non-computability if lifting functions to types outside Prop without well-definedness proof
Forgetting that Quot is not a syntactic datatype
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: Quot.sound (h : a ~ b) or Quotient.lift f h_resp

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: injection h with h1 h2 or contradiction
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Constructor disjointness and injectivity are derived kernel theorems for every inductive type.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Use cases h which automatically discharges impossible constructor combinations and injects arguments into the context.
dialect_pitfalls: Dependent types where indices depend on earlier constructor arguments requiring dependent elimination
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: injection h with h1 h2 or contradiction

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: GaloisConnection l u meaning l a <= b <-> a <= u b
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Algebraic typeclass hierarchy rooted in Preorder, PartialOrder, Lattice, CompleteLattice in Mathlib.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Use GaloisConnection.l_le_iff to rewrite adjunctions; construct fixed points using OrderHom.lfp.
dialect_pitfalls: Typeclass diamond conflicts between different lattice paths (e.g. distributed vs complete lattices)
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: GaloisConnection l u meaning l a <= b <-> a <= u b

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: { x : A // P x } or <val, prop>
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Inductive structure Subtype with fields val and property living in Type.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Use anonymous constructor syntax <x, h> for construction and s.val or s.1 for extraction.
dialect_pitfalls: Propositional equality on subtypes requires Subtype.ext (proof irrelevance on the certificate)
Coercion confusion between the subtype and underlying carrier
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: { x : A // P x } or <val, prop>

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: Classical.choose (h : exists x, P x) and Classical.choose_spec h
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Axiom Classical.choice : Nonempty alpha -> alpha; implies Law of Excluded Middle and functional extensionality.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Scope classical reasoning with open scoped Classical; mark noncomputable functions with noncomputable def.
dialect_pitfalls: Noncomputable definitions cannot be evaluated by the Lean 4 compiler/interpreter (#eval fails)
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: Classical.choose (h : exists x, P x) and Classical.choose_spec h

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: theorem invariant_step (s : State) (h_inv : Inv s) : Inv (step s) and V (step s) <= alpha * V s
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Deterministic and stochastic transition systems formalized as state-transformer relations with integer-scaled arithmetic bounds.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Define inductive predicates for safety invariants; define scalar energy functions V : State -> Nat for termination/convergence.
dialect_pitfalls: Overflows in scaled-integer representations
Loss of monotonicity in composite state spaces
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: theorem invariant_step (s : State) (h_inv : Inv s) : Inv (step s) and V (step s) <= alpha * V s

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: by omega | by linarith [h1, h2] | by ring | by positivity
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Kernel-checked proof-term generation for integer Presburger (`omega`), Fourier-Motzkin linear arithmetic (`linarith`), commutative rings (`ring`), and sign analysis (`positivity`).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Use `omega` for `Nat`/`Int` linear goals, `ring` for polynomial identities, `positivity` for `0 <= x` / `0 < x`, and `linarith`/`nlinarith` for `Rat`/`Real` inequalities.
dialect_pitfalls: Silent `Nat.sub` truncation `a - b = 0` when `a < b`; provide `h : b <= a` before `omega` or `zify`
`ring` does not use local inequality or non-equational hypotheses; pass them to `linarith` instead
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: by omega | by linarith [h1, h2] | by ring | by positivity

mechanisms.canonical_name: Numeric Coercions, Cast Normalization & Denominator Clearing
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: push_cast; ring | zify [h_le] at *; omega | field_simp [hne]; ring
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Bidirectional `@[norm_cast]` attribute classification (`squash`, `move`, `elim`) normalizing ↑ coercions, paired with `zify` (`Nat -> Int` lift) and `field_simp`.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Use `zify [h]` to lift `Nat.sub` to `Int` before `omega`, `push_cast; ring` for mixed-cast equalities, and `field_simp; ring` for rational expressions.
dialect_pitfalls: `Nat.cast_sub` requires `b <= a`; without it `push_cast` cannot push `↑(a - b)` inward
`field_simp` leaves denominator non-zero goals if `positivity` or local hypotheses cannot discharge them automatically
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: push_cast; ring | zify [h_le] at *; omega | field_simp [hne]; ring

mechanisms.canonical_name: Well-Founded Recursion, Termination Measures & Functional Induction
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: def f (x : alpha) : beta := ... termination_by measure x decreasing_by omega | fun_induction f x with ...
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: `WellFounded.fix` compilation with automatic equation lemmas (`f.eq_def`) and functional induction principle (`f.induct`, invoked via `fun_induction`).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Pair `termination_by` + `decreasing_by omega` with `fun_induction f` so proof branches mirror the function's control flow 1-to-1.
dialect_pitfalls: Unfolding a well-founded function via `dsimp` fails because it is compiled via `WellFounded.fix`; use `rw [f]` or `fun_induction f`
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: def f (x : alpha) : beta := ... termination_by measure x decreasing_by omega | fun_induction f x with ...

mechanisms.canonical_name: Measure Spaces, Lebesgue/Bochner Integration & Almost-Everywhere Filters
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: ∫ x in s, f x ∂μ | ∫⁻ x, g x ∂μ | ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, P x | filter_upwards [h1, h2] with x hx1 hx2
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Mathlib `MeasureTheory.Measure` with `∫⁻` (`ENNReal` lower Lebesgue integral), `∫` (Bochner integral returning `0` if non-integrable), and `ae μ` filter.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Discharge measurability via `measurability` or `fun_prop`, combine `∀ᵐ x ∂μ` hypotheses via `filter_upwards`, and use `Integrable f μ` for Bochner linearity.
dialect_pitfalls: `∫⁻` takes values in `ℝ≥0∞` where `∞ - ∞ = 0`; use `∫` (Bochner) for signed cancellation
Bochner `integral_add` requires `Integrable f μ` and `Integrable g μ` side conditions
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: ∫ x in s, f x ∂μ | ∫⁻ x, g x ∂μ | ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, P x | filter_upwards [h1, h2] with x hx1 hx2

mechanisms.canonical_name: Big Operators, Finite Sums/Products & Indexed Monoid Folding
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: ∑ x ∈ s, f x | ∏ x ∈ s, f x | ∑ x ∈ s with P x, f x
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: `Finset.sum` and `Finset.prod` commutative-monoid fold over deduplicated `Finset α` (`open BigOperators`).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Use `Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x hx => ...)` for pointwise rewrites, `Finset.sum_bij` for reindexing, and `Finset.sum_comm` for swapping double sums.
dialect_pitfalls: `Finset.range n` is `[0, n)` (size `n`), whereas `Finset.Icc 1 n` is `[1, n]`; watch index bounds carefully
`Finset.sum_union` requires `Disjoint s t`
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: ∑ x ∈ s, f x | ∏ x ∈ s, f x | ∑ x ∈ s with P x, f x

mechanisms.canonical_name: Bitvectors, Machine Words, SWAR & Bit-Blasting Decision Procedures
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: by bv_decide | by bv_omega | ext i hi; simp [BitVec.getLsbD]
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Kernel-verified LRAT certificate bit-blaster (`bv_decide` via CaDiCaL) and `BitVec`-to-`omega` preprocessor (`bv_omega`).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Use `bv_decide` for all fixed-width (`BitVec 8/16/32/64`) bitwise/arithmetic identities and `BitVec.ext` for parametric widths `BitVec w`.
dialect_pitfalls: `bv_decide` only applies to concrete bit-widths `w`; parametric widths `w : Nat` require `ext i` or induction
Nonlinear multiplication on wide `BitVec 64` can time out in SAT; factor or apply ring lemmas first
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: by bv_decide | by bv_omega | ext i hi; simp [BitVec.getLsbD]

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: ext x y | funext x | congr 1
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Chainable `@[ext]` tactic applying type-directed extensionality lemmas (`funext`, `Set.ext`, `Finset.ext`, `Subtype.ext`, custom `@[ext] structure`) and bounded congruence `congr n`.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Use `ext x` to peel function/set/finset/structure layers in one call, and `congr 1` to match identical outer function heads.
dialect_pitfalls: Unbounded `congr` can over-descend into dependent arguments (`HEq` goals); bound depth with `congr 1` or `congrArg`
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: ext x y | funext x | congr 1

mechanisms.canonical_name: Filters, Nets, Eventualities & Topological Limit Convergence
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: Tendsto f (𝓝 x) (𝓝 y) | Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 l) | ∀ᶠ n in atTop, P n
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Order-lattice `Filter α` where `Tendsto f l₁ l₂` is `Filter.map f l₁ ≤ l₂`, unifying sequence limits (`atTop`), topological neighborhoods (`𝓝 x`), punctured limits (`𝓝[≠] x`), and measure (`ae μ`).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Prove continuity with `fun_prop` (or `continuity`), combine eventualities `∀ᶠ` with `filter_upwards`, and compose limits via `Tendsto.comp` instead of unfolding `(ε, δ)`.
dialect_pitfalls: Avoid unfolding `Metric.tendsto_nhds` to `(ε, δ)` unless proving a base metric primitive
Distinguish `𝓝 x` (includes `x`) from `𝓝[≠] x` (punctured neighborhood used in derivatives)
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: Tendsto f (𝓝 x) (𝓝 y) | Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 l) | ∀ᶠ n in atTop, P n
